G. SUM-1-39

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 9208
Section 1, Special Branch 37
REPORT
Date May 17, 1939.

Subject. Communications from Netherlands Consulate-General dated 2-5-39.
concerning Miss Helena Neumann.

Made by. D.S. Pavloff. Forwarded by. C. Crawford. O. J.

Miss Helena NEUMANN, Polish, was born on
February 24, 1907 in Ksewerin, Poland. She resided
in Poland until 1927, after which she proceeded to
Mukden where she visited her uncle, Mr. J. Neumann,
a proprietor of the "Oriental Hotel" in that city.
She returned to Poland in 1928 and in 1930 again
reappeared in Mukden. She resided in that city,
together with her uncle, until the beginning of 1936
after which she proceeded to Dairen. In June 1937
she left Dairen for Nanking and during her stay in
the latter city worked as a waitress in the Kiessling
Cafe. She arrived in Shanghai from Nanking in
December 1937, shortly after the occupation of Nanking
by Japanese Forces. When registering with the local
Polish Consulate-General, she stated that she is a
dress-maker by occupation. It is believed that
she lives in Shanghai on her uncle's support, who,
it is reported, is in Dairen at present. She also
works privately as a ladies dress-maker at her home,
455/3C4 Rue Lafayette.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police
records concerning Miss Helena Neumann.

l. a. Pavloff -
D. S.

P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br)
D.C. (Special Branch)

G. SUM-1-39

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 9208
特别处第37科第1组
报告
日期：1939年5月17日。

事由：关于荷兰总领事馆1939年5月2日来函，涉及海伦娜·诺伊曼小姐。

制作人：D.S. Pavloff。转呈人：C. Crawford。O. J.

海伦娜·诺伊曼小姐，波兰籍，1907年2月24日出生于波兰克谢韦林（Ksewerin）。她居住在波兰直至1927年，随后前往沈阳，探望其叔父J. 诺伊曼先生（Mr. J. Neumann），后者系该市“东方饭店”（Oriental Hotel）的业主。她于1928年返回波兰，并于1930年再次出现在沈阳。她与叔父一同居住在该市，直至1936年初，随后前往大连。1937年6月，她离开大连前往南京，在逗留期间于基斯林咖啡馆（Kiessling Cafe）担任女服务员。1937年12月，在南京被日军占领后不久，她从南京抵达上海。在向当地波兰总领事馆登记时，她声称自己的职业是裁缝。据信，她在上海的生活依靠其叔父资助，据报道其叔父目前身在大连。她也在位于拉斐特路455号3楼C4室（455/3C4 Rue Lafayette）的家中私下从事女装裁缝工作。

工部局警务处档案中没有任何关于海伦娜·诺伊曼小姐的记录。

l. a. Pavloff -
D. S.

P. A. 致 D. C. (特别处)
D.C. (特别处)

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.1351.                                SHANGHAI,          2nd May 1939.

Sir,

    I have the honour to inform you that Miss Helena
NEUMANN has applied to this Consulate-General for a vise
for admission into the Netherlands Indies.

    Miss Neumann is in possession of a Polish passport
Serie I.No.504122.No.982/35 issued by the Polish Consu-
late at Harbin on September 13, 1935, and extended at
Shanghai until September 13, 1940.

    According to this document she was born at Ksewerin
on February 24, 1907.

    She intends to leave for the Netherlands Indies on
June 8, 1939 where, according to her statement, she will
contract a marriage with Mr. E.J. van Rij, an officer of
the Java China Japan Line.

    She resides at No.455 Rue Lafayette, Apartment 304.

    I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let
me know, if possible, whether anything is known against
this person from a political or moral point of view.

                                        I have the honour to be,

                                                Sir,

                                        Your obedient servant,

                                        Consul-General.

To the Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
                SHANGHAI.
page_data.zh:
荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号 HOLLANDIA。

编号：1351。                                上海，1939年5月2日。

先生：

    谨此通知，海伦娜·诺伊曼小姐已向本总领事馆申请入境荷属东印度的签证。

    诺伊曼小姐持有波兰护照，系列I，编号504122，第982/35号，由波兰驻哈尔滨领事馆于1935年9月13日签发，并在上海延期至1940年9月13日。

    根据该文件，她于1907年2月24日出生于克谢韦林（Ksewerin）。

    她打算于1939年6月8日前往荷属东印度，据她陈述，她将在当地与爪哇-中国-日本航线公司（Java China Japan Line）的一名职员E.J. van Rij先生结婚。

    她居住在拉斐特路455号304室。

    如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否知晓此人有任何不良记录，本人将不胜感激。

                                        此致
                                        敬礼

                                                先生，

                                        您的顺从仆人，

                                        总领事。

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别处副总监
                上海。
